# SummAI — High-Velocity AI Video Intelligence
> Turn any video or lecture into structured executive summaries, synced chapter timestamps, action items, and grounded AI insights using Gemini 3.8 Flash.

## Overview
SummAI is a production-grade video intelligence engine built on Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, and the Google Gen AI SDK (@google/genai). It replaces naive 1 FPS static frame extraction with timeline navigation, reducing token waste by up to 88%.

## Canonical Routes
- `/`: Home dashboard supporting YouTube URL inputs, clipboard paste, video upload staging, sample presets, and fast analysis dispatch.
- `/video/workspace`: Interactive split-pane workspace integrating a synchronized video player (YouTube embed / HTML5 video), chapter seek pills, executive narrative synthesis, bulleted takeaways, action items, searchable transcripts, and grounded AI chat.
- `/api/summarize`: POST endpoint accepting `{ url: string, length?: "short"|"medium"|"detailed", language?: string }` returning strictly conforming JSON video intelligence.
- `/api/chat`: POST endpoint accepting `{ question: string, transcriptText: string }` returning grounded answers citing exact timestamps formatted as `[MM:SS]`.

## Telemetry & Benchmarks
- Model: gemini-3.8-flash / gemini-2.5-flash
- Efficiency Gain: 88%+ Token Reduction
- Timestamp Accuracy: Sub-second timeline grounding
